Definition: The local-first piping stress application governed by this telemetry policy.
A state in which no telemetry transport, endpoint, vendor, upload job, queue, or persistence exists.
A human-approved list defining collectable events with event name, permitted fields, field sensitivity, review date, approving authority, and reason for collection.
Required behavior whereby ambiguous, legacy, or erroneous configuration resolves telemetry to disabled rather than inferring consent.
The core/security/telemetry_policy module that resolves local telemetry configuration and evaluates event attempts on metadata only, before payload construction.
Active filtering applied before any telemetry event is constructed.
Classes of data that telemetry payloads must never include, such as private project models, secrets, model hashes, and code-compliance claims.
Default posture of OpenPipeStress in which operation does not depend on network telemetry.
Surfaces (plugins, adapters, import/export, reports, CLI, diagnostics, services) that cannot circumvent opt-in and payload-filtering rules.
A future TBD workflow requiring explicit user attachment review before any private payload could be included.
